findings.subject: Non-shift modified printable associated text
findings.reason: P1 only selects a character when no non-shift modifier exists. The constructed shortcut event receives that guarded character. This differs from the verified P2 implementation defect. No universal correctness claim follows.

findings.subject: Shifted alternate binding alias
findings.reason: P1 explicitly derives and appends the shifted alternate alias without duplicating Shift. The original ctrl+plus example exists. More modifiers, streaming boundaries or layout interactions still need independent legal-input and contract analysis.

findings.subject: Direct generation behavior coverage
findings.reason: The three R18 proposals for P1 exercise direct Key construction and existing dispatch_key. They do not exercise parser.feed. This observation is about emitted source, not native pass/fail. Original selected scopes do import the parser; absence from the proposal is not proof that parsing was unavailable.

findings.subject: Old event-field edits
findings.reason: Removing an encoded release event field while retaining a release expectation cannot establish a target defect. Input legality and all event metadata must be derived for the changed input.

next_direction: Inspect legal interactions that the original parser tests do not distinguish. Bind expectations to the actual consuming parser and official protocol. Keep abstention if the requirement does not determine the expected behavior. Do not assume every remaining trial has the same known bug as another implementation.
metric_limit: The frozen seventeen-trial optimization denominator stays unchanged. This source diagnosis neither proves P1 correct nor establishes that it has a detectable defect.
